mapper.sql: SELECT AA.* FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS total , A.* FROM (

WITH recursive hierarchy_cte AS (SELECT 1 AS level , CAST(tb2.chld_role_id AS CHAR(4000)) AS ordersb , CAST(tb2.chld_role_id AS CHAR(4000)) AS role_path , tb2.mb_id /* 회사코드 VARCHAR(20) */ , tb2.prnt_role_id /* 부모롤ID VARCHAR(50) */ , tb2.chld_role_id /* 자식롤ID VARCHAR(50) */ , tb2.in_emp_cd /* 입력자사번 VARCHAR(20) */ , tb2.in_dtm /* 입력일시 DATETIME */ , tb2.up_emp_cd /* 수정자사번 VARCHAR(20) */ , tb2.up_dtm /* 수정일시 DATETIME */ FROM (SELECT tb1.* FROM tbsy_roles_hierarchy tb1 WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} AND chld_role_id = #{role_id} ) tb2 UNION ALL SELECT level+1 AS level , CONCAT(hierarchy_cte.ordersb,tb4.chld_role_id) AS ordersb , CONCAT(role_path,'>',tb4.chld_role_id) as role_path , tb4.mb_id /* 회사코드 VARCHAR(20) */ , tb4.prnt_role_id /* 부모롤ID VARCHAR(50) */ , tb4.chld_role_id /* 자식롤ID VARCHAR(50) */ , tb4.in_emp_cd /* 입력자사번 VARCHAR(20) */ , tb4.in_dtm /* 입력일시 DATETIME */ , tb4.up_emp_cd /* 수정자사번 VARCHAR(20) */ , tb4.up_dtm /* 수정일시 DATETIME */ FROM (SELECT * FROM tbsy_roles_hierarchy WHERE mb_id = #{mb_id} ) tb4 JOIN hierarchy_cte ON tb4.chld_role_id = hierarchy_cte.prnt_role_id )
mapper.insert: /* comm-mapper.xml insertAuthNum SMS 인증번호 저장 */ INSERT INTO tbsy_login_auth_num /* [SY][시스템] 로그인 SMS인증번호관리 */ ( mb_id /* 회사코드 VARCHAR2(20) */ , emp_cd /* 사원코드 VARCHAR2(20) */ , auth_num /* SMS인증번호 VARCHAR2(40) */ , in_dtm /* 전송일시 TIMESTAMP */ ) VALUES ( #{mb_id} /* 회사코드 VARCHAR2(20) */ , #{emp_cd} /* 사원코드 VARCHAR2(20) */ , #{auth_num} /* SMS인증번호 VARCHAR2(40) */ , now() /* 전송일시 TIMESTAMP */ )
